title: 第157章 天青云纹广袖仙袍第158章 十万大山龙砂
slug: 别人修仙我闲逛游历三界终长生
content_zh:
纪风走了过去，看向中间那件衣服。
乍一看，这件仙衣浅青朦胧，并不惹眼。
可目光稍作停留，才渐渐察觉到妙处。
衣身隐着浅浅云纹，纹路柔缓如云絮漫卷，不描浓彩，不缀繁饰。
冰蚕雪丝的面料莹润柔和，光泽内敛不晃目，广袖垂落舒展，清雅气韵慢慢漾开。
仙衣整体好看却不张扬，自带一股出尘淡然的感觉。
云织仙走到衣架旁，拉起仙衣的袖口，问道：
“纪公子，这件天青云纹广袖仙袍怎么样？”
“好看。”
纪风的目光落在那件仙衣上，这两个字说的不重，但谁都能听得出来，他很喜欢。
知白在一旁扯着他的衣袖催促道：
“公子，公子，你快穿上试试！”
云织仙也笑道：“衣服是否好看合身，还需公子自己上身才知道。”
绾绾从纪风肩头飞起来，落在一旁的木架上，琥珀色的眼睛望着纪风。
牛渊站在门口，魁梧的身形把门框遮了大半，他也不说话，只是静静看着。
玉尺郎、金剪和银针三个也站在云织仙身后，目光看向纪风，眼中带着期待。
纪风被这么多双眼睛盯着，笑了一下：
“那就穿上试试。”
他脱下身上的青衫，露出里边的内衫。
云织仙抬手一挥，那件天青云纹广袖仙衣便从衣架上飞了起来，在纪风身后停住。

纪风展开双臂，仙衣自动落到肩头，广袖顺着他的手臂滑落，腰间束带自行收紧，衣襟交叠贴合着胸口，每一处褶皱都自然垂落，每一寸尺寸都恰到好处。
冰蚕雪丝的凉意隔着内衫透过来，清冽而不寒冷。
“哇！”
顿时，织云阁里响起一片惊叹。
知白张大了嘴，彩缕童从门后探出脑袋，蚕丝娘捂住了嘴。
纪风站在那儿，天青云纹广袖仙衣衬得他身形修长挺拔。
白玉簪横贯发髻，簪尾露出一小截莹润的光泽，与衣袍的清冷气韵相衬。
衣摆垂至脚踝，广袖舒展，仙衣上的云纹在光线流转间若隐若现，纪风整个人像从山间云雾中走出来的一般。
既有剑客的利落，又有仙家的飘逸，但又不张扬。
只是安安静静地站在那儿，便让人移不开眼，又生不出半点轻薄之意。
逍遥剑从案上自行飞起，落入他手中。
青灰色的剑鞘朴实无华，与这身仙衣搭在一起却意外的和谐。
衣有仙气而不张扬，剑藏锋芒而不外露。
他握剑而立，广袖垂落，剑鞘末端的云纹与袖口的云纹微微呼应，浑然一体。
云织仙一挥手，一面云雾般的圆镜浮现在纪风面前。
镜面澄澈如水，映出他全身的模样。
纪风转过身，在镜前打量了自己一番。
不错，不错，是他想象中逍遥剑仙的模样。
云织仙站在一旁看着镜中的纪风，微微点头笑道：
“若不是在人间遇到公子，我还以为是真武真君麾下的剑仙呢。”

纪风转过身来，笑道：
“仙子谬赞了，是仙子手艺好。”
“仙子仙子，我的呢？”
知白已经迫不及待，跑到另一座衣架前，踮起脚够下那件月白木灵道袍。
道袍颜色月白，比纪风的浅青云纹更素净几分。
content_en:
Ji Feng walked over and looked at the piece of clothing in the middle.
At first glance, this fairy dress is light green and hazy, not eye-catching.
But after his eyes lingered for a while, he gradually realized the beauty.
There are shallow cloud patterns hidden on the body of the clothes. The patterns are as soft and slow as clouds, without strong colors or complicated decorations.
The fabric of ice silk and snow silk is bright and soft, with a restrained luster that does not dazzle the eyes. The wide sleeves drape and stretch, and the elegant charm slowly unfolds.
The overall fairy clothes are good-looking but not ostentatious, with a sense of indifference.
Yun Zhixian walked to the clothes rack, pulled up the sleeves of the clothes, and asked:
"Mr. Ji, how about this fairy robe with wide sleeves and azure cloud pattern?"
"Good looking."
Ji Feng's eyes fell on the fairy clothes. These two words were not emphasized, but everyone could tell that he liked it very much.
Zhibai pulled his sleeves and urged:
"Master, Master, please put it on and try it on!"
Yun Zhixian also smiled and said: "You have to put on the clothes yourself to know whether the clothes look good and fit well."
Wanwan flew up from Ji Feng's shoulder and landed on the wooden frame nearby, looking at Ji Feng with her amber eyes.
Niu Yuan stood at the door, his burly figure covering most of the door frame. He didn't say anything, just watched quietly.
Yu Chilang, Jin Jian and Yi Zhen also stood behind Yun Zhixian, looking at Ji Feng with expectation in their eyes.
Ji Feng was stared at by so many pairs of eyes and smiled:
"Then put it on and try it."
He took off his green shirt, revealing his inner shirt.
Yun Zhixian raised her hand and waved, and the azure cloud-patterned wide-sleeved fairy dress flew up from the hanger and stopped behind Ji Feng.
Ji Feng spread his arms, and the fairy clothes automatically fell to his shoulders. The wide sleeves slid down his arms, the belt around his waist tightened on its own, and the placket overlapped to fit his chest. Every fold fell naturally, and every inch was just the right size.
The coolness of ice silk and snow silk penetrates through the inner shirt, refreshing but not cold.
"Wow!"
Suddenly, there was an exclamation in Zhiyun Pavilion.
Zhibai opened his mouth wide, Cailu Tong poked his head out from behind the door, and Silk Girl covered her mouth.
Ji Feng stood there, his fairy clothes with wide sleeves and azure cloud patterns making him tall and slender.
A white jade hairpin runs across the bun, and the tail of the hairpin reveals a small section of luster, which contrasts with the cool atmosphere of the robe.
The hem of the clothes hangs down to the ankles, and the wide sleeves are stretched. The cloud patterns on the fairy clothes are vaguely visible in the passing light. Ji Feng's entire figure looks like he has stepped out of the clouds and mist in the mountains.
It has the sharpness of a swordsman and the elegance of an immortal, but without being ostentatious.
Just standing there quietly makes people unable to take their eyes away, and there is no hint of frivolity.
Xiaoyao Sword flew up from the table and fell into his hand.
The blue-gray scabbard is simple and unpretentious, but it is unexpectedly harmonious when paired with the fairy clothes.
The clothes are fairy-like but not ostentatious, and the sword hides the sharp edge but not exposed.
He stood with his sword in hand, his wide sleeves hanging down, and the moiré pattern at the end of the scabbard slightly echoed the moiré pattern on the cuffs, making them seamlessly integrated.
Yun Zhixian waved his hand, and a cloud-like round mirror appeared in front of Ji Feng.
The mirror was as clear as water, reflecting his entire body.
Ji Feng turned around and looked at himself in front of the mirror.
Yes, yes, it was the appearance of the Xiaoyao Sword Immortal in his imagination.
Yun Zhixian stood aside and looked at Ji Feng in the mirror, nodded slightly and smiled:
"If I hadn't met the young master in the human world, I would have thought he was a swordsman under Zhenwu Zhenjun."
Ji Feng turned around and said with a smile:
"The fairy is so complimentary. It's the fairy who is good at craftsmanship."
"Fairy Fairy, where's mine?"
Zhi Bai couldn't wait any longer, so he ran to another clothes rack and stood on tiptoe to reach for the moon-white wood spirit Taoist robe.
The color of the Taoist robe is moon-white, which is a bit more plain than Ji Feng's light blue cloud pattern.
